props.classMechanic_text:
VERSES

SINGING A VERSE

To sing a verse, choose a Volume, a Key, and a Tone. These set MP cost, targets, and the verse’s effect.

  • Volume determines cost and which creatures you affect (who can hear you).
  • Key defines the verse’s damage type, applied status, linked Attribute, and what is recovered when a tone restores points.
  • Tone establishes the effect (healing, buffs, damage, statuses, clock interaction, etc.).

VOLUME → MP & Targets

VolumeMPTargets
Low10Yourself or a creature you can see who can hear you.
Medium20Every ally who can hear you.
High30Every enemy who can hear you.

MAGICHANT (Skill)

  • During a conflict, use an action and spend MP (by Volume) to sing a verse.
  • Limit: you may sing one verse per turn, even if you have multiple actions.
  • When first acquired, learn all three Volumes, plus one Key and one Tone.
  • Each time you acquire this Skill again, learn one additional Key or Tone.

KEYS

KeyTypeStatus EffectAttributeRecovery
Flame@UUID[Item.0sFCVCoM6FRrQP2f]{Fire}@UUID[JournalEntry.ImFKpNNGjstom7Q9]{Shaken}MIGHP
Frost@UUID[Item.Osq3NN3QCtiW7otU]{Ice}@UUID[JournalEntry.KYehgac3Pw1fKC9S]{Weak}WLPMP
Iron@UUID[Item.XpKZuGo3VmT0TlTu]{Physical}@UUID[JournalEntry.HHmYmj7xffQMqtzT]{Slow}WLPMP
Radiance@UUID[Item.5XAuMMbDPlLzhJLw]{Bolt}@UUID[JournalEntry.ImFKpNNGjstom7Q9]{Shaken}DEXHP
Shadow@UUID[Item.IQaK3IzvfFp4I1xB]{Light}@UUID[JournalEntry.3nmUvPei3zrOJkEt]{Dazed}INSHP
Stone@UUID[Item.vKU8UYT6DBhgOjtE]{Dark}@UUID[JournalEntry.KYehgac3Pw1fKC9S]{Weak}DEXMP
Thunder@UUID[Item.ZyOMe6IkUTlBzfjw]{Earth}@UUID[JournalEntry.3nmUvPei3zrOJkEt]{Dazed}MIGHP
Wind@UUID[Item.imkMQLnCLaFbaS6Y]{Air}@UUID[JournalEntry.HHmYmj7xffQMqtzT]{Slow}INSMP

Key terms referenced by tones: [key type], [key status effect], [key Attribute], and [key recovery] (HP or MP as shown above).

TONES

ToneEffect
CalmEach target recovers [key recovery] equal to 10 + twice your current WLP die size. Increase by +10 at level 20+, or +20 at level 40+. If this would restore MP, it has no effect on the singer.
EnergeticUntil the start of your next turn, when a target succeeds on a Check that includes [key Attribute] and that Check would advance or turn back a Clock, they may fill or erase one additional section of that Clock.
FranticEach target suffers [key type] damage equal to twice your current WLP die size. Deal +10 damage at level 20+, or +20 damage at level 40+.
HauntingEach target suffers [key status effect]. Each target also loses Resistance to [key type] damage (if they have it) until the start of your next turn.
LivelyEach target treats their [key Attribute] as one die size higher (maximum d12) until the start of your next turn.
MenacingThe first time each target suffers damage before the start of your next turn, that damage becomes [key type]. Triggers once for each target affected by the verse.
SolemnEach target recovers from [key status effect] and gains Resistance to [key type] damage until the start of your next turn.

props.class_lore:
Whether tracing their fingers on a delicate harp, dazing an unprepared audience with the sheer power of their vocals, or happily diving into a crowd of delirious fans, Chanters could be described as magical one person orchestras!

A Chanter’s abilities reach way beyond the normal limits of music and singing: they rely on the strength of their souls and weave magical energy into songs, supporting their allies during tense situations
